candidates.claim: sw-core-01 has an SNMP community in RW mode with no access-list restriction (acl null), which violates the requirement that SNMP communities be read-only and restricted to MGMT hosts.
candidates.remediation: Remove the RW SNMP community on sw-core-01, or change it to RO and bind it to the MGMT-only SNMP_NMS access list.

candidates.claim: The baseline-delta record shows the snmp-server community line at sw-core-01:213 was added relative to the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added SNMP community with the approved baseline: revert it or document it as an approved change.
